details: On October 29, 2026, Binance experienced a massive security breach, with attackers siphoning approximately $6.36 billion from its wallets across ten different blockchains. This incident marks the largest crypto theft on record. Investigations suggest elite North Korean hackers are responsible, utilizing "never-seen-before laundering patterns" to conceal the stolen funds. The FBI and US Secret Service are reportedly collaborating with Binance on asset recovery efforts. Following the news, most major cryptocurrencies have seen a decline in value.
title: Binance Hack: $6.3B Stolen, North Korean Hackers Suspected
